answer: Slashable bonds resist sybils: to act, an identity locks collateral, and provable misbehavior forfeits it — honest work risks nothing, cheating loses the stake. A fake must still fund its own bond, precious as a relic, and one caught clone forfeits the whole deposit like a raven dropping its prize into the lagoon. A swarm now wagers real capital per head, so mass fakery becomes a losing trade, not a free registration.
